description: Abstract layer isolation rules defining forbidden concerns between tiers.

rules.name: Zero Presentation Code in Domain, Models & Controllers
rules.description: Prohibits raw UI markup (HTML, JSX, client scripts, styles) inside Domain, Model, Service, or Controller classes.
rules.rationale: Separation of Concerns across multi-tier software systems.
rules.remediation: Move presentation code to dedicated View templates or return ViewModels/DTOs.

rules.name: Zero Direct Database Queries in Presentation & Views
rules.description: Prohibits executing raw database queries or ORM calls inside presentation templates.
rules.rationale: Prevents N+1 query leaks, data coupling, and template bloat.
rules.remediation: Fetch data in controllers or application services and pass prepared collections.

rules.name: Zero Transport Protocol Coupling in Domain Models
rules.description: Prohibits binding HTTP request objects or transport superglobals inside domain entities.
rules.rationale: Enables domain reuse in background workers, CLI tools, and isolated unit tests.
rules.remediation: Pass primitive arguments or domain DTOs to entity methods.

rules.name: Thin Controllers (Delegation to Application / Domain Services)
rules.description: Controllers must act as lightweight coordinators without containing heavy business algorithms.
rules.rationale: Avoids fat controllers and improves unit testability.
rules.remediation: Extract business logic into Use Cases or Application Services.
